en.Windows скачивает обновления и приложени: Windows downloads updates and Store apps only from Microsoft servers and does not share them with other computers.
en.Соответствует выключенному переключателю: Matches the switch Settings → Windows Update → Advanced options → Delivery Optimization turned off. Turns off sharing updates with other PCs. By default Windows shares them only on the local network, so this affects ping only if internet sharing was on before; the downloads themselves work as before. No policy is used, so the switch in Settings stays available. Fully takes effect after a restart.
en.Режим оптимизации доставки задан группов: The Delivery Optimization mode is set by Group Policy.
en.При питании от сети адаптер Wi-Fi работа: When plugged in, the Wi-Fi adapter runs in maximum performance mode.
en.Убирает задержки и скачки пинга, когда а: Removes delays and ping spikes when the adapter “falls asleep” between packets. Only the plugged-in value of the current power plan changes; battery operation on a laptop is not changed.
en.Если «ускоритель интернета» отключил или: If an “internet accelerator” turned off or limited TCP receive window auto-tuning, restores the standard Windows level (normal).
en.Без автонастройки одно соединение упирае: Without auto-tuning a single connection is capped by a 64 KB window: by Microsoft's calculation, on a 1 Gbit/s link with 10 ms latency that is only about 51 Mbit/s, so downloads in Steam, the browser and launchers run noticeably slower. The normal level is the Windows default in all editions; on a healthy system this item changes nothing. Sometimes auto-tuning is turned off on purpose — because of an old router or firewall that handles TCP window scaling (RFC 1323) poorly. If connections got worse after applying, undo the item: the previous level is restored exactly. A level set by Group Policy is not changed by MONOLITH. Does not affect ping in games. Takes effect immediately for new connections. If your line has bufferbloat (ping grows during downloads — “Devices & network” → “Load test”), fast downloads fill the router's queue more and ping during downloading can rise: this is fixed by SQM on the router or a speed limit in the launcher, not by turning auto-tuning off.
en.Уровень автонастройки задан групповой по: The auto-tuning level is set by Group Policy, or the TCP templates are configured differently — MONOLITH does not change them because it could not restore each one exactly.
en.уровень автонастройки TCP задан группово: the TCP auto-tuning level is set by Group Policy — MONOLITH does not change it
en.шаблоны TCP настроены по-разному ({0});: TCP templates are configured differently ({0}); a single command could not restore each of them exactly, so MONOLITH does not change them
en.Снимает ограничение обработки сетевых па: Removes the network packet processing limit that Windows applies while multimedia is playing.
en.Механизм времён Windows Vista влияет на: A mechanism from the Windows Vista era affects network throughput only while multimedia is playing (MMCSS) and does not change latency in games: the popular “ping reduction” claim here is a myth. Restart required.
This setting does not reduce ping in games. The change is not dangerous, but it brings no benefit on most systems either — enable it only deliberately.
en.Для активных сетевых адаптеров Windows п: For active network adapters Windows acknowledges every TCP packet immediately, without delay (TcpAckFrequency = 1).
en.Может снизить задержку только в старых M: May reduce latency only in old MMOs that use TCP and do not turn off the Nagle algorithm themselves. Most games use UDP or enable TCP_NODELAY on their own — for them there is no difference, and there are more overhead packets. Microsoft (KB 328890) advises changing this setting only deliberately. Restart or adapter reconnect required.
en.Помогает лишь отдельным старым онлайн-иг: Helps only some old TCP-based online games and increases the amount of overhead traffic. Microsoft does not recommend changing this setting without need.
en.Не найдено активных физических сетевых а: No active physical network adapters found.
en.Предпочитать IPv4, если IPv6 хуже: Prefer IPv4 if IPv6 is worse
en.Для адресов, доступных по обоим протокол: For addresses reachable over both protocols, Windows picks IPv4. IPv6 stays enabled.
en.Вариант, который Microsoft рекомендует в: The option Microsoft recommends instead of disabling IPv6: DisabledComponents = 0x20 changes only the address preference table. Needed only if the measurement in “Devices & network” showed that IPv6 at your provider is noticeably worse than IPv4 (by 10 ms or more, or with losses) — this happens with broken or tunneled IPv6. Most game servers use IPv4, so this usually does not affect ping in games; it helps launchers and websites. If the value is already set with other bits (partial IPv6 disable), MONOLITH does not change it. Undo restores the previous value. Restart required.
en.Только если замер показал, что IPv6 хуже: Only if the measurement showed that IPv6 is worse than IPv4. Usually no difference in games; restart required.
en.Нужен, только если замер в «Устройства и: Needed only if the measurement in “Devices & network” → “Ping test” showed that IPv6 is noticeably worse than IPv4, and the DisabledComponents value is not set yet.
en.DisabledComponents уже задан другими бит: DisabledComponents is already set with other bits — MONOLITH does not change it
en.Активные сетевые адаптеры переключаются: Active network adapters are switched to {0} DNS servers (IPv4 and IPv6).
en.Помогает, только если DNS провайдера мед: Helps only if your provider's DNS is slow or unreliable: websites and launchers start opening faster. Does not affect ping in games. You can check whether it is faster for you in “Devices & network” → “DNS speed”: the router's DNS is often faster than public ones. All active network adapters are changed. Each adapter's previous settings (automatic from the router, or manual addresses) are remembered and restored on undo; the computer's address registration in DNS (adapter properties) is not changed, neither on apply nor on undo. Do not use it if you have a corporate network or a VPN with its own DNS, Pi-hole/AdGuard Home, or parental controls on the router.
en.Cloudflare не передаёт подсеть клиента: Cloudflare does not pass the client subnet (ECS), so region-bound services sometimes pick a farther server — even if the name lookup itself became faster.
